summary: Backend: 43/43 pytest tests passed against public URL (adds 13 new tests for incident lifecycle + register-push in test_incidents_and_push.py). Verified: POST /api/incidents returns {incident,draft} with status=OPEN, current_stage=INVESTIGATING, draft.sequence=1, draft.incident_id set, draft.validations={}. POST /api/incidents/{id}/updates creates draft.sequence=2 with prefilled values (title, business_application, countries, product_team all carried over) and validations={} (reset). GET /api/incidents lists with update_count; GET /api/incidents/{id} returns updates ordered by sequence with progress {validated,total}. mark-sent sets last_sent_at + current_stage; RESOLVED-stage mark-sent flips incident.status=RESOLVED and sets resolved_at. DELETE /api/incidents/{id} soft-deletes both incident and its drafts (verified not in /api/drafts or /api/incidents afterwards). 404 paths verified for bad template/incident/draft ids. /api/register-push exists (not 404) and returns controlled 502 with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY (no crash). 422 for missing fields. All existing endpoints still pass (5 IMCR + 3 Non-IMCR templates, 150+ products, 36 processes, 21 countries, drafts CRUD, IMCR/Non-IMCR recipient rules, contingency). Frontend: Templates tab opens compose successfully; the countries multi-select section (business_impact) NOW LOCKS after Countries → Done → Validate & Lock (previous regression FIXED). Incidents tab renders with incident cards showing update count and sent status; incident detail shows update thread timeline; 'Post next update' picker opens with 5 stage options; picking IDENTIFIED creates prefilled draft (title='T input-title' carried) with validations RESET (progress 0 of 7) and stage pill 'Identified' — all as per spec. HOWEVER a SEPARATE compose validation blocker remains for the 'timing' section: when a user types values across ALL sections and then clicks Validate & Lock sequentially from top, validate-timing (fields issue_started + next_update) refuses to lock (progress sticks at 3 of 7). Reproduced deterministically. Isolated repro (clicking validate-timing right after typing only its two fields) works — so root cause is state churn during earlier validate-triggered save/invalidate cycles, not the initial typing. Backend logic itself remains proven correct; user cannot reach Send/Preview without workaround.

ui_bugs.component: app/compose/[id].tsx — Validate & Lock for the 'timing' section
ui_bugs.issue: After user types into all 11 inputs, picks dropdowns + countries, then clicks Validate & Lock top-to-bottom, validate-subject/status/incident lock fine, then validate-timing silently fails. Progress freezes at 3 of 7. Reproduced across multiple runs (previous iterations saw the same pattern on different sections; this iter it's 'timing'). Isolated repro (open compose → type only issue_started + next_update → click validate-timing) DOES lock, so the trigger is state churn from earlier validate cycles: each validate fires save → mutation → invalidateQueries(['draft',id]) → refetch. During the refetch window, when user quickly clicks the next validate, section.fields.some(!current[f.key]) returns true even though state clearly holds the typed text (verified via input DOM value). Suggested fix: remove queryClient.invalidateQueries(['draft', id]) from useUpdateDraft.onSuccess (or set staleTime: Infinity for the ['draft', id] key while compose is mounted). Alternatively, on refetch success write server values back into local state only if hydrated is still false — which is already the case, so the more effective fix is stopping the refetch entirely.

rca_of_issue: Compose sections re-render under LinearTransition (line 211 of compose/[id].tsx). Each Validate & Lock click causes: (1) setValidations updates state, (2) queueMicrotask fires save → useUpdateDraft mutation → PUT /api/drafts/{id}, (3) mutation.onSuccess invalidates ['draft', id] in src/api.ts, (4) useDraft refetches, (5) draft prop changes → useEffect fires but hydrated=true so setValues is skipped. In a rapid top-to-bottom validate sequence, steps 2-5 happen while the user is already clicking the next section's validate button; the LinearTransition reflow + section card key stability + the intermediate render where `draft` swaps identity can cause the onPress handler bound to the Animated.View to briefly reference a stale stateRef read even though stateRef itself is updated on every render (line 68-69). Empirically the failing section shifts between runs (iter1: 'timing'; iter2: 'business_impact'; iter3: 'timing' again) which supports a race hypothesis over any single field's validation logic. Mitigation: eliminate the ['draft', id] invalidation to remove the refetch → identity churn cycle; the local state is already the source of truth during compose.
